title: Ideas and Firm Dynamics When It Takes Two to Tango
title_zh: 思想与公司动态：当合作需要双方共舞时
title_primary: 思想与公司动态：当合作需要双方共舞时
title_secondary: Ideas and Firm Dynamics When It Takes Two to Tango
authors: Seula Kim, Jane Olmstead-Rumsey, Honghao Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Teams of inventors now produce over 80% of U.S. patents, up from just 45% in 1976. Over the same period, inventor employment has become increasingly concentrated in large firms, rising six times more than overall employment concentration. To explain these trends, we develop a new model of endogenous team formation within firms and embed it in a general equilibrium model of the inventor labor market. Teams increase firms' returns to scale by increasing the likelihood of productive matches between inventors. The value of these matches rise over time, possibly driven by increasing knowledge specialization. This causes large firms to expand and small firms to shrink in equilibrium, accounting for the observed increase in inventor employment concentration. Because firms do not internalize knowledge spillovers, there is misallocation of inventors across firms. The rise of team production amplifies this misallocation by a factor of six by reallocating inventors away from small firms that generate disproportionately large knowledge spillovers.
abstract_zh: 如今，美国超过80%的专利由发明人团队产出，而1976年这一比例仅为45%。同期，发明人就业日益集中于大型企业，其集中度增幅是整体就业集中度的六倍。为解释这些趋势，我们构建了一个企业内团队形成的内生新模型，并将其嵌入发明人劳动力市场的一般均衡模型中。团队通过提高发明人之间有效匹配的可能性，增强了企业的规模报酬。这些匹配的价值随时间上升，可能源于知识专业化程度的加深。这导致均衡状态下大企业扩张、小企业收缩，从而解释了观察到的发明人就业集中度上升现象。由于企业未将知识溢出内部化，发明人在企业间的配置存在错配。团队生产的兴起通过将发明人从小企业重新分配出去，加剧了这种错配，其影响程度放大六倍，而小企业恰恰产生了不成比例的巨大知识溢出。

title: The Inference‐Forecast Gap in Belief Updating
title_zh: 信念更新中的推断-预测差距
title_primary: 信念更新中的推断-预测差距
title_secondary: The Inference‐Forecast Gap in Belief Updating
authors: Tony Q. Fan, Yucheng Liang, Cameron Peng
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Evidence from the laboratory and the field has uncovered both underreaction and overreaction to new information. We provide new experimental evidence on the underlying mechanisms of under‐ and overreaction by comparing how people make inferences and revise forecasts in the same information environment. Participants underreact to signals when inferring about underlying states, but overreact to the same signals when revising forecasts about future outcomes—a phenomenon we term “the inference‐forecast gap.” We show that this gap is largely driven by different simplifying heuristics used in the two tasks. Additional treatments suggest that the choice of heuristics is affected by the similarity between statistics in the information environment and the statistic elicited by the belief‐updating problem.
abstract_zh: 来自实验室和现场的证据揭示了人们对新信息既存在反应不足也存在反应过度。我们通过比较人们在相同信息环境下如何进行推断和修正预测，提供了关于反应不足与反应过度内在机制的新实验证据。参与者在推断潜在状态时对信号反应不足，但在修正对未来结果的预测时却对相同信号反应过度——我们将这一现象称为“推断-预测差距”。研究表明，这一差距主要由两项任务中使用的不同简化启发式策略驱动。额外实验处理表明，启发式策略的选择受到信息环境中的统计量与信念更新问题所引发的统计量之间相似性的影响。

title: Social-Science Genomics: Progress, Challenges, and Future Directions
title_zh: 社会科学基因组学：进展、挑战与未来方向
title_primary: 社会科学基因组学：进展、挑战与未来方向
title_secondary: Social-Science Genomics: Progress, Challenges, and Future Directions
authors: Benjamin, Daniel J., Cesarini, David, Turley, Patrick, Young, Alexander Strudwick
official: 来源期次 Journal of Economic Literature · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Rapid progress has been made in identifying links between human genetic variation and social and behavioral phenotypes. Applications in mainstream economics are beginning to emerge. This review aims to provide the background needed to bring the interested economist to the frontier of social-science genomics. Our review is structured around a statistical framework that nests many of the key methods, concepts and tools found in the literature. We clarify key assumptions and appropriate interpretations. After critically reviewing several significant applications, we conclude by outlining future advances in genetics that will enable more and improved applications, and we discuss the ethical and communication challenges that arise in this area of research.
abstract_zh: 人类遗传变异与社会及行为表型之间的关联研究已取得快速进展，其在主流经济学中的应用也初现端倪。本综述旨在为感兴趣的经济学家提供必要背景知识，助其了解社会科学基因组学的前沿领域。我们围绕一个统计框架展开综述，该框架整合了文献中的诸多关键方法、概念与工具，并阐明核心假设与恰当解读方式。在批判性评述若干重要应用后，我们最后展望了遗传学领域的未来进展——这些进展将推动更多、更优的应用实践，同时探讨该研究领域所引发的伦理与沟通挑战。

title: When is Separate Sales Optimal?

abstract: This paper studies a multi-product monopolist facing a privately informed consumer with additive and type-increasing valuations. Separate monopoly pricing is robustly optimal with respect to the type distribution if and only if the marginal rate of substitution between each pair of goods is monotone. This result is obtained by extending the conventional Myersonian approach.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个面临具有加性且类型递增估值的知情消费者的多产品垄断者。当且仅当每对商品之间的边际替代率是单调的时，分离垄断定价对类型分布具有稳健最优性。这一结果是通过扩展传统的迈尔森方法得出的。

title: Second-hand gentrification: Theory and evidence from high-speed rail extensions
title_zh: 二手绅士化：高铁延伸的理论与实证
title_primary: 二手绅士化：高铁延伸的理论与实证
title_secondary: Second-hand gentrification: Theory and evidence from high-speed rail extensions
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Does gentrification spread along intercity transport connections? We study the 2017 French high-speed rail (HSR) extensions from Paris to Bordeaux and Rennes. We build a model where HSR reduces the cost of accessing a primary city from a secondary one, enabling skilled workers to enjoy the primary city’s labor market while living in the more affordable secondary city. This induces migration from the primary to the secondary city, raising housing prices there. Empirically, the HSR connection raised housing prices in Bordeaux and Rennes by 12%, central-neighborhood median income by 2%, and within-neighborhood inequality by 2%. Near Montparnasse, the connecting Paris terminal, prices fell 4% relative to the rest of Paris.

title: Health Sector Structural Change
title_zh: 卫生部门的结构性变革
title_primary: 卫生部门的结构性变革
title_secondary: Health Sector Structural Change
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The U.S. health-services sector has grown both in terms of its expenditure share and relative price. Using a two-sector general equilibrium model with monopolistic competition and endogenous population, we find that relative price growth is almost entirely attributable to increasing relative sectoral markups. Demand effects from aging play only a minor role driving up prices and expenditure shares. Controlling for GE effects and rising relative markups, we estimate that health-sector TFP has grown since the 1980s at a rate greater than 1% annually, dampening relative price growth, while leading to higher health-sector output, partially driving up aggregate expenditure shares.
abstract_zh: 美国健康服务部门的支出份额和相对价格均有所增长。通过构建一个包含垄断竞争和内生人口的两部门一般均衡模型，我们发现相对价格增长几乎完全归因于部门间相对加成率的上升。老龄化带来的需求效应对价格上涨和支出份额增加的推动作用微乎其微。在控制一般均衡效应和相对加成率上升的条件下，我们估算自20世纪80年代以来，健康部门的全要素生产率年均增长率超过1%，这抑制了相对价格增长，同时促进了健康部门产出提升，并部分推高了总支出份额。

title: Which demand elasticity should a monopoly use?
title_zh: 垄断应使用哪种需求弹性？
title_primary: 垄断应使用哪种需求弹性？
title_secondary: Which demand elasticity should a monopoly use?
official: 官方在线 2026-07-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Consider a non-durable goods monopolist who maximizes the present discounted value of profits. In steady state, which elasticity (short run or long run) should the monopolist use in the classic inverse-elasticity rule? Under some assumptions, the appropriate elasticity is a convex combination of the short-run and long-run elasticities of demand, where the weights depend upon the monopolist’s discount factor and the dynamics inherent in demand.

title: On the Efficiency of Runnable Banking Arrangements
title_zh: 论可运行银行安排的效率
title_primary: 论可运行银行安排的效率
title_secondary: On the Efficiency of Runnable Banking Arrangements
official: 官方在线 2026-07-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Financial arrangements involving illiquid assets financed by liquid liabilities are often viewed as inherently runnable. Diamond and Dybvig (1983) show that this is true when risk-sharing arrangements are not optimally designed. Peck and Shell (2003) and Ennis and Keister (2009, 2016), however, demonstrate that runnable banking arrangements can be constrained-efficient when liquidity demand is uncertain and withdrawals must be processed on a first-come, first-served basis. We show that this insight extends to environments in which redemptions are not subject to a sequential service constraint. Instead, increasing returns to scale in banking-consistent with empirical evidence-can generate regions of the parameter space in which the constrained-efficient allocation is runnable. Runnable banking arrangements can be constrained-efficient when the minimum scale required to realize economies of scale is difficult to attain during large redemption events, when the penalty for failing to achieve scale is small, and when the likelihood of a coordinated run is low 1 1 The authors are grateful to Todd Keister, Manuel Amador, and two anonymous referees for very helpful comments and criticisms. The views expressed here are those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect those of the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta or the Federal Reserve System. .

title: The distribution of reproduction during a fertility transition: declining spread of parenthood in Brazil
title_zh: 生育转变期间的生育分布：巴西父母身份扩散的下降
title_primary: 生育转变期间的生育分布：巴西父母身份扩散的下降
title_secondary: The distribution of reproduction during a fertility transition: declining spread of parenthood in Brazil
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Demographers have a rich understanding of the fertility transitions that have been observed in many contexts. Yet, we lack evidence to explain whether long-run declines in fertility levels are accompanied by simultaneous changes in reproductive variability. This is important because reproductive variability—the concentration and dispersion of childbearing—may help to better explain fertility trends and predict population change. We address this gap with a case study of Brazil, which is a well-known example of fertility transition, using microdata on fertility by education for cohorts born 1910–1970. We contribute by using multiple measures of variability in completed fertility, studying how these measures change during an entire transition, how they relate to cohort fertility rates, and how this evidence varies by education. Reproductive variability declines across the Brazilian fertility transition—for measures of concentration and dispersion—although this is less evident for dispersion measures that adjust for levels of children ever born. We also find considerable differences by education and evidence that several measures of variability are predictive of fertility decline, highlighting a promising avenue for future research. Moreover, our findings suggest that conclusions based on one measure of variability may only provide a partial understanding of population dynamics.
abstract_zh: 人口学家对多国背景下观察到的生育率转变已有深入理解，但长期生育率下降是否伴随生育变异性的同步变化仍缺乏证据支撑。这一问题至关重要，因为生育变异性——即生育行为的集中度与离散度——可能有助于更精准地解释生育率趋势并预测人口变动。本研究以巴西为典型案例（该国是生育率转变的著名范例），利用1910-1970年出生队列按教育程度划分的生育微观数据填补这一空白。我们通过多重指标测量终身生育率的变异性，考察这些指标在整个转变过程中的变化规律、与队列生育率的关联性，以及不同教育群体间的差异。研究发现：巴西生育率转变期间，生育变异性（包括集中度与离散度指标）整体呈下降趋势，但经调整终身生育水平后的离散度指标变化不明显。不同教育群体间存在显著差异，且多项变异性指标对生育率下降具有预测作用，这为未来研究指明了重要方向。此外，研究结果表明，仅基于单一变异性指标得出的结论可能仅能部分反映人口动态全貌。

title: Government procurement as a catalyst: Reshaping firm entry-exit dynamics in China
title_zh: 政府采购作为催化剂：重塑中国企业进入与退出动态
title_primary: 政府采购作为催化剂：重塑中国企业进入与退出动态
title_secondary: Government procurement as a catalyst: Reshaping firm entry-exit dynamics in China
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Government procurement is a key demand-side policy tool for state intervention in the economy, as it not only directly influences micro-corporate decision making but also shapes regional industry dynamics. Nevertheless, its industry-level impacts remain underexplored. This study adopts the perspective of firm entry and exits to investigate how government procurement shapes regional industry dynamics. We find that government procurement significantly increases the entry of new firms in regional industries while also promoting firm exit. A series of robustness tests and IV-based causal identification demonstrate the reliability of the result. Mechanism analysis reveals that, on the one hand, by raising the proportion of contracts awarded to local firms, government procurement sends a policy signal of supporting local industry, thereby encouraging both entry and exit. On the other hand, by prefer small and medium-sized enterprises (SME), it enhances market competition and stimulates firm entry and exit. Further analysis shows that: first, government procurement also generates supply-chain spillover effects, extending its influence to upstream and downstream industries; second, the distribution of procurement contracts among firms within an industry moderates the impact of procurement; third, the impact of government procurement on the entry and exit of enterprises ultimately enhances the industry's innovation capability; and finally, the effect of government procurement on firm entry and exit is stronger in regions with a better business environment. This study provides policy insights for optimizing government procurement policies to promote regional industrial development.

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper considers the estimation of a censored partial linear quantile regression model with endogeneity. Our method extends those for partial linear quantile regression (Lee, 2003, Qu et al. 2024), nonparametric quantile regression (Qu and Yoon, 2015, Belloni et al., 2019), and censored linear quantile regression with endogeneity (Chen, 2018). Our estimation method involves a tractable sequential-multiple-step procedure. We establish the uniform consistency, the uniform representation and the asymptotic normality for the proposed estimators. We further extend our analysis to allow for sample selection. A set of Monte Carlo experiments show that our estimators have a good finite sample performance and an empirical application is given to show the usefulness of our estimators.

title: The Fentanyl Shock: Synthetic Opioids and the Supply of Organ Donors
title_zh: 芬太尼冲击：合成阿片类药物与器官捐赠者供给
title_primary: 芬太尼冲击：合成阿片类药物与器官捐赠者供给
title_secondary: The Fentanyl Shock: Synthetic Opioids and the Supply of Organ Donors
authors: Omar Martin Fieles-Ahmad, Selina Schulze Spuentrup
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study how the diffusion of illicit synthetic opioids affected the supply of deceased organ donors in the United States after 2012. As fentanyl spread rapidly from east to west, it produced sharp, uneven increases in overdose mortality across states. We first study the arrival of fentanyl as a dichotomous shock in a difference-in-differences framework at the organ procurement organization (OPO) level, contrasting regions east and west of the Mississippi River due to drug-market segmentation. We then turn to the intensive margin using a state-level IV approach that leverages the westward diffusion of fentanyl over time, with exposure measured using fentanyl mortality. Both approaches show that fentanyl exposure caused large increases in overdose-driven donor supply and transplanted organs, revealing how a lethal epidemic reshaped the availability of transplantable organs.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2012年后非法合成阿片类药物的扩散如何影响美国已故器官捐献者的供给。随着芬太尼从东向西迅速蔓延，各州因药物过量导致的死亡率出现了剧烈且不均衡的增长。我们首先在器官获取组织（OPO）层面，采用双重差分框架将芬太尼的传入视为二分冲击，并因毒品市场分割而对比密西西比河东西部地区。随后，我们利用州级工具变量法（IV）深入分析集约边际，该方法借助芬太尼随时间向西扩散的趋势，并以芬太尼死亡率衡量暴露程度。两种方法均表明，芬太尼暴露导致药物过量驱动的器官捐献者供给及移植器官数量大幅增加，揭示了一场致命疫情如何重塑了可移植器官的可及性。

title: Measuring Inequality of Opportunity in Asia and the Pacific
title_zh: 亚太地区机会不平等程度的测度
title_primary: 亚太地区机会不平等程度的测度
title_secondary: Measuring Inequality of Opportunity in Asia and the Pacific
authors: Gaurav Datt, John Nguyen, Pedro Salas-Rojo, Francisco H.G. Ferreira, Paolo Brunori 等
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper aims to contribute to an understanding of the extent, nature and persistence of unfair inequality in the Asia Pacific region, building on a rich literature on the measurement of inequality of opportunity (IOp). As part of a project to build a global database of IOp, the paper uses microdata from 39 nationally representative household surveys to present IOp estimates for 14 countries that account for about three-quarters of the regionÃ¢â‚¬â„¢s population. We use consistent data protocols to ensure a high degree of cross-country comparability of IOp estimates. A distinguishing feature of the exercise is the use of machine learning methods to construct IOp estimates, which efficiently balances the risks of potential under- or over-fitting. The results show that, on average, nearly two-fifths of income or consumption inequality across the Asia-Pacific region represents inequality of opportunity attributable to inherited circumstances, though with wide variation across countries, ranging from about a quarter to over half. The cross-country variation in IOp is consistent with a Great Gatsby curve for the Asia-Pacific. A decomposition analysis assesses the relative contributions of different circumstances to IOp.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在基于机会不平等（IOp）测度的丰富文献，深化对亚太地区不公平不平等的程度、性质及持续性的理解。作为构建全球IOp数据库项目的一部分，本文利用39项具有全国代表性的家庭调查微观数据，对占该地区人口约四分之三的14个国家进行了IOp估算。我们采用一致的数据处理协议，以确保IOp估算结果具有高度的跨国可比性。本研究的显著特征在于运用机器学习方法构建IOp估算，有效平衡了潜在欠拟合或过拟合的风险。结果显示，亚太地区收入或消费不平等中，平均近五分之二可归因于继承性环境因素造成的机会不平等，但各国差异显著，范围从约四分之一到超过一半不等。IOp的跨国差异与亚太地区的“盖茨比曲线”一致。分解分析评估了不同环境因素对IOp的相对贡献。

title: College Loans and Human Capital Investment
title_zh: 大学贷款与人力资本投资
title_primary: 大学贷款与人力资本投资
title_secondary: College Loans and Human Capital Investment
authors: Chao Fu, Hsuan‐Chih (Luke) Lin, Atsuko Tanaka
official: 官方在线 2026-06-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: College loans facilitate access to education, but the repayment burden may distort posteducation human capital investment. We examine the role of college loans and loan repayment policies through a structural model of individuals' dynamic decisions on borrowing/saving, labor supply, and costly human capital investment. We estimate two versions of the model using data from NLSY79: one with natural borrowing limits and another with parameterized limits. Counterfactual simulations suggest that, relative to the standard fixed repayment plan, income‐driven repayment (IDR) plans modestly increase educational attainment, lifetime earnings, and individual welfare; accounting for lifetime income taxes, they also increase government revenue.

abstract: Digital platforms may manipulate customer reviews to impede other consumers from acquiring accurate information and to increase sales. In a rational inattention setting where consumers acquire information about product quality before making purchasing decisions, we show that the platform has incentives to restrict information acquisition in the presence of consumers with wishful thinking. These biased consumers are unaware of their bias and weigh any good news about the product quality more heavily than a Bayesian consumer. We identify the conditions under which the firm optimally constrains information acquisition, and characterize when competition can alleviate this type of exploitation. Our results extend to a broader class of non-Bayesian rules beyond wishful thinking.

source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization

abstract: Incumbents’ reputations acquired during their time in office influence voters’ choices. Some studies suggest that, when designing their campaign messages, incumbents might benefit from playing to their strengths and emphasizing fewer issues than challengers. In this paper, I provide causal empirical evidence to support this hypothesis using information from mayoral elections in Brazil and a regression discontinuity design. The findings indicate that incumbency causes campaign manifestos to be more concentrated. Moreover, incumbents who belong to a cohesive and programmatic party tend to emphasize party-specific issues more. This suggests that reputation matters for issue selection. To measure issue emphasis and manifesto concentration, I leverage a unique database of more than 28 thousand documents containing political manifestos and use a Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) algorithm to estimate a vector of topics – or the issues emphasized by each candidate. With this information, I calculate Herfindahl Hirschman Indices (HHI) for each manifesto to assess their relative issue concentration.

title: On the Design of Effective Sanctions: The Case of Bans on Exports to Russia
title_zh: 有效制裁的设计：对俄出口禁令案例研究
title_primary: 有效制裁的设计：对俄出口禁令案例研究
title_secondary: On the Design of Effective Sanctions: The Case of Bans on Exports to Russia
authors: Ricardo Hausmann, Ulrich Schetter, Muhammed A. Yıldırım
official: 官方在线 2026-02-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We analyze the effects of bans on exports at the level of 5,000 products and show how our results can inform economic sanctions against Russia after its invasion of Ukraine. We begin with characterizing export restrictions imposed by the EU and the US until mid-May 2022. We then propose a theoretically-grounded criterion for targeting export bans at the 6-digit HS level. Our results show that the cost to Russia are highly convex in the market share of the sanctioning parties, i.e., there are large benefits from coordinating export bans among a broad coalition of countries. Applying our results to Russia, we find that sanctions imposed by the EU and the US are not systematically related to our arguments once we condition on Russia’s total imports of a product from participating countries. Quantitative evaluations of the export bans show (i) that they are very effective with the welfare loss typically ∼100 times larger for Russia than for the sanctioners. (ii) Improved coordination of the sanctions and targeting sanctions based on our criterion allows to increase the costs to Russia by about 60% with little to no extra cost to the sanctioners. (iii) There is scope for increasing the cost to Russia further by expanding the set of sanctioned products.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了5000种产品层面的出口禁令效应，并展示了研究结果如何为俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后对其采取的经济制裁提供依据。首先，我们梳理了截至2022年5月中旬欧盟与美国实施的出口限制措施。随后，我们提出一个基于理论依据的六位HS编码层面出口禁令目标选择标准。研究结果表明，俄罗斯承担的成本与制裁方的市场份额呈高度凸性关系，即广泛国家联盟协调实施出口禁令能带来显著收益。将研究结果应用于俄罗斯案例时发现，在控制俄罗斯从参与国进口某产品的总量后，欧盟与美国的制裁措施与我们的理论依据并不存在系统性关联。对出口禁令的量化评估显示：（i）制裁效果显著，俄罗斯的福利损失通常约为制裁方的100倍；（ii）通过优化制裁协调并基于我们的标准精准选择制裁目标，可在几乎不增加制裁方额外成本的情况下，使俄罗斯承担的成本提升约60%；（iii）通过扩大受制裁产品范围，仍有进一步提升俄罗斯成本的潜力。

title: Hitting Rock Bottom: Economic Hardship and Cheating
title_zh: 跌入谷底：经济困境与欺骗行为
title_primary: 跌入谷底：经济困境与欺骗行为
title_secondary: Hitting Rock Bottom: Economic Hardship and Cheating
authors: Livia Alfonsi, Michal Bauer, Julie Chytilová, Edward Miguel, Tushi Baul 等
official: 官方在线 2026-01-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates whether economic hardship undermines preferences for honesty. We use controlled, high-stake measures of cheating for private benefit in a large sample of 5,664 Kenyans, exploiting three complementary sources of variation: experimentally manipulated monetary incentives to cheat, a randomized increase in the salience of one’s own financial situation, and the Covid‑19 income shock (exploiting randomized survey timing, with respondents interviewed before vs. during the crisis). We find that cheating behavior is highly responsive to financial incentives in the experiment. Covid-19 economic hardship—marked by a 51% drop in monthly earnings—leads to a sharp increase in the prevalence of cheating, and the effect increases gradually with prolonged hardship. The effects are largest among the most economically impacted and are amplified when the salience of one’s own financial situation is experimentally increased. The results demonstrate that while most individuals exhibit a strong preference against cheating under normal conditions (in line with the existing body of work), economic forces can account for a substantial share of variation in dishonesty: the estimated cheating rate rises from 29% under low stakes in normal times to 86% under high stakes during the crisis.
abstract_zh: 本文探究经济困境是否会削弱人们对诚实的偏好。我们基于5,664名肯尼亚人的大样本，采用受控的高风险欺骗行为测量方法，利用三种互补的变异来源：实验操控的欺骗金钱激励、随机增强个人财务状况凸显性，以及新冠疫情收入冲击（利用随机调查时间安排，受访者分别在危机前和危机期间接受访谈）。研究发现，实验中的欺骗行为对金钱激励高度敏感。新冠疫情导致的经济困境——月收入下降51%——显著提高了欺骗行为的普遍性，且该效应随困境持续而逐步增强。经济冲击最严重的群体受影响最大，当通过实验增强个人财务状况凸显性时，该效应进一步放大。结果表明，尽管大多数人在正常条件下表现出强烈的反欺骗偏好（与现有研究一致），但经济因素可解释不诚实行为中相当大比例的变异：在正常时期的低风险情境下，估计欺骗率为29%，而在危机期间的高风险情境下，该比率上升至86%。
